audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Zophar's second speech: urgency of reply, short joy of the wicked, swallowed wealth, poison imagery, exposure by heaven/earth, and allotted fate. Marked as Zophar's speech, not final theology.

verses.restored: Zophar the Naamathite answered and said:

familiar.text: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

modern.text: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:

original.text: וַ֭יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַנַּֽעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר

verses.restored: Therefore my troubled thoughts answer me, because of my haste within me.

familiar.text: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.

modern.text: “So my anxious thoughts compel me to answer, because of the turmoil within me.

original.text: לָ֭כֵן שְׂעִפַּ֣י יְשִׁיב֑וּנִי וּ֝בַעֲב֗וּר ח֣וּשִׁי בִֽי

verses.restored: I hear a correction that insults me, and a spirit from my understanding answers me.

familiar.text: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.

modern.text: I have heard a rebuke that insults me, and my understanding prompts a reply.

original.text: מוּסַ֣ר כְּלִמָּתִ֣י אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וְ֝ר֗וּחַ מִֽבִּינָתִ֥י יַעֲנֵֽנִי

verses.restored: Do you not know this from old, since humanity was placed on earth,

familiar.text: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,

modern.text: Do you not know that from antiquity, since man was placed on the earth,

original.text: הֲזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתָּ מִנִּי עַ֑ד מִנִּ֤י שִׂ֖ים אָדָ֣ם עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: that the shouting of the wicked is short, and the joy of the godless is only for a moment?

familiar.text: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?

modern.text: the triumph of the wicked has been brief and the joy of the godless momentary?

original.text: כִּ֤י רִנְנַ֣ת רְ֭שָׁעִים מִקָּר֑וֹב וְשִׂמְחַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף עֲדֵי רָֽגַע

verses.restored: Though his height rises to the heavens and his head reaches the clouds,

familiar.text: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;

modern.text: Though his arrogance reaches the heavens, and his head touches the clouds,

original.text: אִם יַעֲלֶ֣ה לַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שִׂיא֑וֹ וְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ לָעָ֥ב יַגִּֽיעַ

verses.restored: he perishes forever like his own dung; those who saw him say, Where is he?

familiar.text: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?

modern.text: he will perish forever, like his own dung; those who had seen him will ask, ‘Where is he?’

original.text: כְּֽ֭גֶלֲלוֹ לָנֶ֣צַח יֹאבֵ֑ד רֹ֝אָ֗יו יֹאמְר֥וּ אַיּֽוֹ

verses.restored: He flies away like a dream and is not found; he is chased away like a vision of the night.

familiar.text: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

modern.text: He will fly away like a dream, never to be found; he will be chased away like a vision in the night.

original.text: כַּחֲל֣וֹם יָ֭עוּף וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָא֑וּהוּ וְ֝יֻדַּ֗ד כְּחֶזְי֥וֹן לָֽיְלָה

verses.restored: The eye that saw him will not see him again, and his place will behold him no more.

familiar.text: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.

modern.text: The eye that saw him will see him no more, and his place will no longer behold him.

original.text: עַ֣יִן שְׁ֭זָפַתּוּ וְלֹ֣א תוֹסִ֑יף וְלֹא ע֝֗וֹד תְּשׁוּרֶ֥נּוּ מְקוֹמֽוֹ

verses.restored: His children will seek the favor of the poor, and his hands will return his wealth.

familiar.text: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.

modern.text: His sons will seek the favor of the poor, for his own hands must return his wealth.

original.text: בָּ֭נָיו יְרַצּ֣וּ דַלִּ֑ים וְ֝יָדָ֗יו תָּשֵׁ֥בְנָה אוֹנֽוֹ

verses.restored: His bones are full of his youth, but it will lie down with him in the dust.

familiar.text: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.

modern.text: The youthful vigor that fills his bones will lie down with him in the dust.

original.text: עַ֭צְמוֹתָיו מָלְא֣וּ עלומו וְ֝עִמּ֗וֹ עַל עָפָ֥ר תִּשְׁכָּֽב

verses.restored: Though evil is sweet in his mouth, though he hides it under his tongue,

familiar.text: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;

modern.text: Though evil is sweet in his mouth and he conceals it under his tongue,

original.text: אִם תַּמְתִּ֣יק בְּפִ֣יו רָעָ֑ה יַ֝כְחִידֶ֗נָּה תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֽוֹ

verses.restored: though he spares it and does not let it go, holding it in the midst of his palate,

familiar.text: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:

modern.text: though he cannot bear to let it go and keeps it in his mouth,

original.text: יַחְמֹ֣ל עָ֭לֶיהָ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑נָּה וְ֝יִמְנָעֶ֗נָּה בְּת֣וֹךְ חִכּֽוֹ

verses.restored: his food is turned in his bowels; it becomes venom within him.

familiar.text: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.

modern.text: yet in his stomach his food sours into the venom of cobras within him.

original.text: לַ֭חְמוֹ בְּמֵעָ֣יו נֶהְפָּ֑ךְ מְרוֹרַ֖ת פְּתָנִ֣ים בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ

verses.restored: He swallows wealth, but vomits it up; the Divine drives it out of his belly.

familiar.text: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.

modern.text: He swallows wealth but vomits it out; God will force it from his stomach.

original.text: חַ֣יִל בָּ֭לַע וַיְקִאֶ֑נּוּ מִ֝בִּטְנ֗וֹ יוֹרִשֶׁ֥נּוּ אֵֽל

verses.restored: He sucks the venom of cobras; the tongue of a viper kills him.

familiar.text: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.

modern.text: He will suck the poison of cobras; the fangs of a viper will kill him.

original.text: רֹאשׁ פְּתָנִ֥ים יִינָ֑ק תַּֽ֝הַרְגֵ֗הוּ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֶפְעֶֽה

verses.restored: He will not look on the streams, the rivers flowing with honey and curds.

familiar.text: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.

modern.text: He will not enjoy the streams, the rivers flowing with honey and cream.

original.text: אַל יֵ֥רֶא בִפְלַגּ֑וֹת נַהֲרֵ֥י נַ֝חֲלֵ֗י דְּבַ֣שׁ וְחֶמְאָֽה

verses.restored: He returns what he labored for and does not swallow it; according to the wealth of his exchange, he will not rejoice.

familiar.text: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.

modern.text: He must return the fruit of his labor without consuming it; he cannot enjoy the profits of his trading.

original.text: מֵשִׁ֣יב יָ֭גָע וְלֹ֣א יִבְלָ֑ע כְּחֵ֥יל תְּ֝מוּרָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲלֹֽס

verses.restored: For he crushed and abandoned the poor; he seized a house he did not build.

familiar.text: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;

modern.text: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor; he has seized houses he did not build.

original.text: כִּֽי רִ֭צַּץ עָזַ֣ב דַּלִּ֑ים בַּ֥יִת גָּ֝זַ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יִבֶנֵֽהוּ

verses.restored: Because he knew no quiet in his belly, he will not escape with what he desires.

familiar.text: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.

modern.text: Because his appetite is never satisfied, he cannot escape with his treasure.

original.text: כִּ֤י לֹא יָדַ֣ע שָׁלֵ֣ו בְּבִטְנ֑וֹ בַּ֝חֲמוּד֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט

verses.restored: Nothing escaped his eating; therefore his prosperity will not endure.

familiar.text: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.

modern.text: Nothing is left for him to consume; thus his prosperity will not endure.

original.text: אֵין שָׂרִ֥יד לְאָכְל֑וֹ עַל כֵּ֝֗ן לֹא יָחִ֥יל טוּבֽוֹ

verses.restored: In the fullness of his abundance he will be distressed; every hand of trouble will come against him.

familiar.text: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.

modern.text: In the midst of his plenty, he will be distressed; the full force of misery will come upon him.

original.text: בִּמְלֹ֣אות שִׂ֭פְקוֹ יֵ֣צֶר ל֑וֹ כָּל יַ֖ד עָמֵ֣ל תְּבוֹאֶֽנּוּ

verses.restored: To fill his belly, the Divine will send fierce anger against him and rain it upon him as his food.

familiar.text: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.

modern.text: When he has filled his stomach, God will vent His fury upon him, raining it down on him as he eats.

original.text: יְהִ֤י לְמַלֵּ֬א בִטְנ֗וֹ יְֽשַׁלַּח בּ֭וֹ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ וְיַמְטֵ֥ר עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ בִּלְחוּמֽוֹ

verses.restored: He flees from an iron weapon; a bronze bow pierces him.

familiar.text: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.

modern.text: Though he flees from an iron weapon, a bronze-tipped arrow will pierce him.

original.text: יִ֭בְרַח מִנֵּ֣שֶׁק בַּרְזֶ֑ל תַּ֝חְלְפֵ֗הוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת נְחוּשָֽׁה

verses.restored: He draws it out, and it comes from his body; the glittering point comes from his gall. Terrors come upon him.

familiar.text: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.

modern.text: It is drawn out of his back, the gleaming point from his liver. Terrors come over him.

original.text: שָׁלַף֮ וַיֵּצֵ֪א מִגֵּ֫וָ֥ה וּ֭בָרָק מִֽמְּרֹרָת֥וֹ יַהֲלֹ֗ךְ עָלָ֥יו אֵמִֽים

verses.restored: All darkness is stored up for his treasures; a fire not blown will consume him; what remains in his tent will suffer harm.

familiar.text: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.

modern.text: Total darkness is reserved for his treasures. A fire unfanned will consume him and devour what is left in his tent.

original.text: כָּל חֹשֶׁךְ֮ טָמ֪וּן לִצְפּ֫וּנָ֥יו תְּ֭אָכְלֵהוּ אֵ֣שׁ לֹֽא נֻפָּ֑ח יֵ֖רַע שָׂרִ֣יד בְּאָהֳלֽוֹ

verses.restored: The heavens will reveal his guilt, and the earth will rise against him.

familiar.text: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.

modern.text: The heavens will expose his iniquity, and the earth will rise up against him.

original.text: יְגַלּ֣וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם עֲוֺנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֶ֗רֶץ מִתְקוֹמָ֘מָ֥ה לֽוֹ

verses.restored: The increase of his house will depart, flowing away in the day of his anger.

familiar.text: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

modern.text: The possessions of his house will be removed, flowing away on the day of God’s wrath.

original.text: יִ֭גֶל יְב֣וּל בֵּית֑וֹ נִ֝גָּר֗וֹת בְּי֣וֹם אַפּֽוֹ

verses.restored: This is the portion of a wicked person from the Divine, the inheritance appointed to him by God.

familiar.text: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.

modern.text: This is the wicked man’s portion from God, the inheritance God has appointed him.”

original.text: זֶ֤ה חֵֽלֶק אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְנַחֲלַ֖ת אִמְר֣וֹ מֵאֵֽל
